sources.label: Falcon Finance transparency and security guide

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The 2026-07-20 review recorded provider shares of 95.4% for Falcon-controlled multisig wallets, 2.5% for Ceffu and 2% for Fireblocks; these are historical review values, not current allocations. The issuer API's 2026-09-30 snapshot reports per-asset ceffu, multisig and fireblocks balance labels, additional reserve venue labels, and an empty venues object, without establishing current legal custody-provider shares. Falcon names Fireblocks and Ceffu for MPC custody and off-exchange settlement, but the reviewed sources do not establish current account-level segregation, insolvency treatment or signer structure. Assets remain actively deployed into trading and yield strategies; no protective custody-field upgrade is inferred.
